title: Add stale-finding SLA to JOB-SEC-001 to prevent findings ageing without disposition
summary: JOB-SEC-001 is detecting but not closing recurring issues. SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 are 9+ days open with no disposition. A stale-finding SLA rule is needed.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16) found that JOB-SEC-001 (Security role) is generating findings but not closing them. SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 (trust_model.multi_user_heuristic) and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 (non-elevated PF posture) are both 9+ days open. Without a stale-finding SLA, the security job generates detection without resolution discipline. Required: (1) define a stale-finding SLA (e.g. 7 days to disposition: accept/fix/defer); (2) add SLA enforcement check to JOB-SEC-001 job definition; (3) apply SLA retroactively to the two open stale findings by forcing a decision/acceptance record.
desired_outcome: JOB-SEC-001 job definition includes stale-finding SLA; SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 formally dispositioned (accept or fix).
success_signal: No open security findings older than SLA threshold without an explicit disposition record.
